_comment: Seed data for the hangar. Type data in reims-f172m.json; compass cards in js/aircraft.js.

SX-ASV._coloursNote: FPL item 19 A/ (e.g. WHITE BLUE STRIPES). No source found: not in the AFM, weighing or compass swing reports, and the club website (mesogeion-aeroclub.gr/ourplane_eng.php) shows only its panel. Left empty for the pilot to fill in the hangar; the FPL export warns until then.

emptyMass._note: Report prints 103.97 cm in the SUM row and 104.03 cm as the C.G.; 71911.59 / 691.20 = 104.04 cm.

SX-ASV.utilityNote: Utility: no rear passengers, no baggage; front seats set forward to 0.90 m (club W&B calculator).

SX-ASG._coloursNote: FPL item 19 A/. From the club's exterior photo of SX-ASG after its repaint (mesogeion-aeroclub.gr/images/ground-to-ground/SXASG_reborn_20141028.jpg, linked from ourplane_eng.php): white, with red and black fuselage cheat lines and tail flash. To be confirmed by the pilot in the hangar.

equipment._source: FPL item 19 J/: the 2024 weighing report lists 4 life vests on board (emptyMass._note). Light, fluorescein and radios are not stated, so only J/ is declared.

emptyMass._source: Weight and balance report signed 28 FEB 2024, scales calibrated 22-JAN-24 (trn-docs/SXASG_WB_FORM_2024.pdf)
emptyMass._note: Weighed with fuel tanks and fuel system empty, oil full (8 qt), 4 life vests, fire extinguisher, flight manual. Unusable fuel (15 L) must be added. CG 113.98 cm is ~10 cm aft of SX-ASV's.

_crosscheck: Club calculator envelope (moment kg·m, mass kg): utility (600,675) (780,890) (807,905) (927,905) (700,675); normal (600,675) (780,890) (1020,1043) (1258,1043) (805,675). Digitised from the AFM chart; within ~1% of the AFM limits used in reims-f172m.json. It uses fuel arm 1.22 m (AFM sheet: 1.215).
